entries.title: Titus 1:1
segments: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

entries.title: Titus 1:2
segments: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;

entries.title: Titus 1:3
segments: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

entries.title: Titus 1:4
segments: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

entries.title: Titus 1:5
segments: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;

entries.title: Titus 1:6
segments: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.

entries.title: Titus 1:7
segments: For the bishop must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;

entries.title: Titus 1:8
segments: but given to hospitality, as lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;

entries.title: Titus 1:9
segments: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.

entries.title: Titus 1:10
segments: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,

entries.title: Titus 1:11
segments: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

entries.title: Titus 1:12
segments: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.

entries.title: Titus 1:13
segments: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

entries.title: Titus 1:14
segments: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

entries.title: Titus 1:15
segments: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

entries.title: Titus 1:16
segments: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
